title: Manufacturer selling products: can Sales quote goods?

steps.do: New quote → Line items: Description "SS316 fire hose reel cabinet", Qty 50.
steps.observed: The line takes "SS316 fire hose reel cabinet", Qty 50.

steps.expect: No "Nos / pieces / kg" in the built-in list (Man-day, Man-month, Per visit, Audit day, Per lot / lump sum, Per document, Per km, Other). Use Other. Record as a GAP unless your administrator adds "Nos" under Admin → Masters (charge unit list) — if added, check it appears here.
steps.observed: With Profile D (Manufacturing & engineering) the unit list offers Man-day, Man-month, Per visit, Audit day, Per lot / lump sum, Per document, Per km, Other, Nos, Set, Kg, Tonne, Metre, Litre, Box, Pair and a new line starts in "Nos" — goods units are built in since 12 Nov 2026 (SAL-004 step 4), so there is no gap and no need for "Other".
steps.suggest: Unit → "Nos" is offered and is the starting unit of a new line (also Set, Kg, Tonne, Metre, Litre, Box, Pair); the service units (Man-day …) are still there for service lines.

steps.expect: There is no HSN / SAC field on a quotation line. Record as a GAP.
steps.observed: No HSN / SAC field on the quotation line (nor anywhere on the form) — GAP confirmed, as the test expects.

steps.expect: Offers inspection types only. Record as a GAP for product companies.
steps.observed: The Service box draws from the "Types of inspection requested" list (37 inspection/audit types, e.g. Inspection (third-party / TPI), Expediting, Resident / site posting, Vendor assessment) — nothing for a product. GAP confirmed.
Subtotal ₹9,25,000; GST ₹1,66,500; total ₹10,91,500 (stored and on the page).

steps.expect: No dedicated fields — only Terms text. Record as a GAP.
steps.observed: No delivery period, freight, packing or warranty field — only the Terms text box. GAP confirmed.

steps.expect: Record how the document reads to a buyer of goods.
steps.observed: PDF line: "Subject: 50 fire hose reel cabinets"; title "QUOTATION", letterhead "TB Inspection Services Pvt Ltd (TEST)"; terms still read as a service firm's (Person-day; man-day; Inspection is carried out; Reports are issued); no HSN, delivery, freight or warranty lines.
steps.reason: The test asks how the document reads to a buyer of goods — a judgement.
steps.proposed: For Profile D the default terms should be a goods seller's (delivery period, freight, packing, warranty, HSN with GST rate per item); today it reads like an inspection body's quotation with a goods line in it — record as a GAP for product companies.
